description:
Goal
Populate callable and boundary facts in the independent TransportPlan. Callable identity, direct transport, first-class materialization, and published boundary contracts must be explicit facts, not recovered from broad callable types or old native boundary selection.

Required facts
CallableId facts name target symbol/executable resolution, capture shapes, capture lanes, direct surfaces, materialization kind, and associated BoundaryIds. BoundaryId facts name one published callable contract: callable, surface arg shapes, published capture lanes, published arg lanes, return shape/lane contract, and boundary context.

Sharing rule
CallableId and BoundaryId descriptors may include immutable key material, including executable-like symbols, when that is the identity. Root/value/callsite publication evidence should live in TransportPlan facts unless it truly changes the descriptor identity. Maximize sharing by default; narrow identity only when required for correctness.

Source rule
Use callable demand, exact surfaces, escape/opaque evidence, local producers, captures, and callsite summaries. Do not select boundaries by scanning callable-looking types below the plan. Do not use NativeCallableBoundaryId or old callable-entry inventories as authority.

Checks
Fixtures prove: unused callable constructor publishes no BoundaryId; direct lambda call uses CallableId and no first-class boundary; escaped lambda publishes exactly the demanded BoundaryId; opaque callable demand has explicit BoundaryId; two callables with same surface but distinct capture obligations remain distinguishable only where the facts require it.
title: Transport flow graph: derive CallableId and BoundaryId facts without type recovery
